from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyTaxExpense(BaseModel):
    """One company's income tax expense reported in its financial statement."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="The company name as stated in the financial report")
    tax_expense_amount: float | None = Field(description="The income tax expense amount as reported")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="The unit/scale of the amount: '元', '百万元', '亿元', etc.")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period, e.g., '2024年第一季度'")
    quote: str = Field(description="The verbatim line or excerpt containing the tax expense figure")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_tax_expenses: list[CompanyTaxExpense]
